Made From Cow Dung

Every piece begins with sacred cow dung

Sun-dried and hand-shaped by rural women artisans — no plastic, no chemicals, 100% biodegradable. It's what makes each Utsav piece sacred, sustainable, and rooted in tradition.

100% Biodegradable

Returns to the soil as manure. No plastic, no waste.

Rural Women Artisans

Every piece hand-shaped by women in Indian villages.

Sacred & Traditional

Rooted in ritual — diyas, idols, dhoop, malas.

Conscious Gifting

For festivals, weddings, temples & corporate desks.
